title: At least the disco ball is gone..
content:
If I could turn off every stupid useless feature on this, I would.

I want a library.  I want a music player.  I want playlists.  I want HiDef Music.  Its pretty simple.

What I dont want, is I don't want AI Generated this and that.  I don't want an AI DJ.  I dont want Lyrics being pulled from a 3rd Party Website.  I don't want Song DNA being pulled from a 3rd Party Website.  I don't even really want Canvas.

And most importantly, I dont want Spotify to arbitrarily stop playback for no reason whatsoever.  I have gone through forum after forum, and turned off everything possible, just to get a vanilla experience.

Youtube streams.  Apple Music Streams.  Soundcloud Streams.  Spotify?  No, it will just stop streaming at the end of a song for no reason.... It never used to be like this until Spotify became a bloated mess with every dumb feature that can't be turned off of.  Fix it.

author: daisypip
title: Wither Music?
content: This kind of thing is excusable in a car type situation, given that they don’t build cars with cassette decks or CD players any more, but I don’t use it anywhere else. I much prefer a solid something in my musical listening. I’m not a vinyl lunatic or anything but I do prefer an object to all this ‘streaming’ business. Perhaps it’s mere fetishisation, yes, for music does indeed live in the ether, the air, but then there are covers, sleeves, etc to be considered. It’s certainly fair to ask ‘Where is music?’ and the answer is clearly ‘Well, quite as much on Spotify, etc as it is on any record or tape (not to mention the radio, of course)’, but still, but still. Beyond which and besides, I’d rather think my favourite artists are getting a goodly lump than some so-called tech-whizz type, to be honest. All of which said, my main gripe is actually with the present day and the future, and by using what some might see as outmoded mechanisms or whatever I can at least try to cling to some vestige of the past, the dying world, or something.

Search has always been bad - but as the offering increases, you’re often stuck with the first tranche of results with no concept of page two. Adding information to the search usually just adds bad results rather reordering good ones to the top.

There’s no real way see information from a long title. Anything too far left is forever invisible. Tables visible on the desktop app aren’t to be found on the mobile app! Why? Then again in the absence of columns sorting and filtering- tables on the desktop are no good if it doesn’t fit on a single screen.

I can’t define a subsection of a long musical piece in a playlist. In opera that often means you’re stuck with 10 minutes surrounding the 3 minute aria or chorus you want.

These all feel one intern week away from implementing. Boo!


In some places locally searching a playlist now works. Good.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

J’utilise Spotify depuis longtemps et c’est de loin la meilleure application de musique que j’ai essayée. L’interface est simple, moderne et très facile à utiliser.
